authority: Planning catalogue only. A template does not authorize a dependency or game implementation.
ownerPolicy: Penpot owns visual experiments. The catalogue owns surface constraints and owner decisions. Exact prose remains in the copy exchange.

writingFrames.title: Prisma toast
writingFrames.note: Production CSS uses a 380px maximum at 1080p and 14px/13px title/body type. Large and higher-resolution modes scale separately.

writingFrames.title: Vanilla MessageBox
writingFrames.frame: 660x420 design target; engine layout is content, font, resolution, and UI-replacer dependent
writingFrames.note: MESG Name is not visible. Treat the body and buttons as the complete vanilla presentation; verify final records in game.

writingFrames.title: Prisma choice
writingFrames.note: All choices and stakes must remain identical to the vanilla fallback even when the layout is richer.

writingFrames.title: Prisma detail panel
writingFrames.frame: 840px width; maximum height is viewport minus 72px
writingFrames.note: The panel scrolls, but the first viewport should still establish state and next action without scrolling.

writingFrames.title: Book of Days
writingFrames.frame: 1180x720 fixed design canvas, scaled to fit
writingFrames.note: Long-form capacity is not permission to repeat transient UI; entries should remain individually scannable.

families.title: Established PDV and Skyrim surfaces
families.summary: Available without adding a new PDV UI dependency.

families.title: Extensions within the existing UI stack
families.summary: Build on Prisma or SkyUI already present in the project.

families.title: Optional framework dependencies
families.summary: Feasible, but each adds compatibility and support surface.

families.title: Bespoke interface work
families.summary: Maximum control with the highest build and maintenance cost.

templates.title: Vanilla notification
templates.pdvUse: Frequent short acknowledgements and fallback toasts.
templates.recommendedFor: Routine acknowledgement that must not interrupt play.
templates.caution: Easy to miss; poor for consequences or choices.
templates.fallback: Remain silent or record in Book of Days.

templates.title: MessageBox
templates.pdvUse: Survey, commitment fallback, setup, curse, and cultural choices.
templates.capacity: Short body; buttons must stay very short
templates.recommendedFor: Consequential decisions and information that cannot be missed.
templates.caution: Interruptive; vanilla MESG Name is not displayed.

templates.title: Active Effects entry
templates.pdvUse: Blessings, neglect, prices, and mechanical descriptions.
templates.recommendedFor: Current mechanical truth and persistent conditions.
templates.caution: Players may not inspect it; weak for narrative acknowledgement.

templates.title: Book or note
templates.pdvUse: Book of Days and persistent devotional chronicle.
templates.recommendedFor: Chronicle, lore, reflection, and durable history.
templates.caution: Poor for urgent information; long journals need navigation discipline.
templates.implementationRoute: BOOK record plus dynamic text owner

templates.title: Player-invoked status power
templates.pdvUse: Survey Devotion lesser power.
templates.recommendedFor: Diegetic, player-owned access to current state.
templates.caution: Competes for the power slot and adds activation friction.
templates.fallback: MCM Player page or Prisma panel.
templates.implementationRoute: SPEL/MGEF script to manager status API

templates.title: SkyUI MCM
templates.pdvUse: Player settings, status, explicit opens, and gated developer controls.
templates.recommendedFor: Configuration and detailed player-owned inspection.
templates.caution: Non-diegetic; avoid making it the only gameplay explanation.

templates.title: Dialogue and subtitles
templates.pdvUse: Curated recognition and shrine/service interactions.
templates.dependency: Skyrim; voice assets if fully voiced
templates.recommendedFor: Recognition delivered by a credible in-world speaker.
templates.caution: CK, conditions, voice, and localization multiply cost.

templates.title: Quest journal and objective
templates.pdvUse: Not a regular PDV surface today.
templates.pause: Objective update does not pause; journal does
templates.capacity: Very short objective plus quest text
templates.recommendedFor: A durable vow, rupture, pilgrimage, or real destination.
templates.caution: Objective spam makes devotion feel like task tracking.

templates.title: Tutorial or help prompt
templates.pdvUse: Not used as a formal PDV surface.
templates.recommendedFor: First-use explanation of an unfamiliar control or rule.
templates.caution: Never repeat routine lore or progress information here.
templates.fallback: MCM help text or player guide.

templates.title: Map or quest marker
templates.pdvUse: Not used for general devotion status.
templates.pause: No update interruption; map view pauses
templates.recommendedFor: A real pilgrimage, shrine, or destination selected by design.
templates.caution: Do not turn abstract devotion into GPS errands.
templates.implementationRoute: REFR map marker or quest target

templates.title: Item, spell, or power tooltip
templates.pdvUse: Blessing powers, devotional items, and readable inventory descriptions.
templates.recommendedFor: What an owned devotional object or ability does.
templates.caution: Not suitable for event chronology.

templates.title: Prisma toast
templates.pdvUse: Non-blocking event acknowledgement with vanilla fallback.
templates.recommendedFor: Visible acknowledgement richer than a vanilla notification.
templates.caution: Must fail safely and must not become notification spam.

templates.title: Prisma detail panel
templates.pdvUse: Focused devotion, medallion, instruments, and current-state detail.
templates.pause: Player-owned; input capture depends on mode
templates.recommendedFor: Layered current state and contextual explanation.
templates.caution: Gameplay must not auto-open a blocking panel.
templates.fallback: Survey, MCM, and Book of Days.
templates.implementationRoute: Typed panel payload plus web view

templates.title: Prisma choice cards
templates.pdvUse: Enhanced commitment choice with vanilla MessageBox fallback.
templates.pause: Design-dependent; current choice surface is explicit
templates.recommendedFor: Important choices needing clearer comparison than horizontal buttons.
templates.caution: Fallback stakes and available choices must remain identical.
templates.implementationRoute: Typed choice payload and response callback

templates.title: Prisma timeline or chronicle
templates.pdvUse: Not yet implemented as a dedicated view.
templates.recommendedFor: Book-of-Days history, causes, milestones, and recent direction.
templates.caution: Needs bounded data and clear separation from raw debug ledgers.
templates.implementationRoute: New typed history payload and web component

templates.title: SkyUI HUD widget
templates.pdvUse: Not currently used.
templates.recommendedFor: An exceptional persistent state such as lapse or active vow.
templates.caution: A permanent piety bar would weaken roleplay and add HUD clutter.

templates.title: UIExtensions list menu
templates.pdvUse: Not currently a dependency.
templates.recommendedFor: Large structured selections where MessageBox buttons do not fit.
templates.caution: Adds an old external menu dependency and support burden.

templates.title: UIExtensions wheel menu
templates.pdvUse: Not currently a dependency.
templates.recommendedFor: Fast repeated selection among a small stable set.
templates.caution: Poor fit for prose-heavy theological decisions.

templates.title: TrueHUD resource or custom widget
templates.pdvUse: Not currently a dependency.
templates.capacity: Bar, icon, target info, or custom SWF
templates.recommendedFor: A genuinely continuous resource or exceptional combat-facing state.
templates.caution: Piety is not automatically improved by being exposed as a meter.
templates.fallback: SkyUI widget or no HUD display.

templates.title: Bespoke Scaleform menu
templates.pdvUse: No dedicated PDV Scaleform menu.
templates.dependency: SKSE, ActionScript/SWF, native or Papyrus bridge
templates.recommendedFor: A requirement Prisma cannot satisfy and that justifies long-term ownership.
templates.caution: Highest implementation, accessibility, resolution, and maintenance cost.
